content: PAY-001 Card Authorization verifies that a valid card is authorized end to end: tokenization, gateway authorization, and an approved status written back to the order. It does not cover capture or refund.
PAY-002 Card Refund verifies a full refund against a previously captured payment, including refund reference creation and the resulting balance adjustment.

PAY-003 3DS Challenge verifies a payment that requires a 3DS redirect. The test waits for the issuer callback and is sensitive to gateway and callback latency; it is the most timing-dependent payment test.
WAL-001 Wallet Top Up verifies adding funds to a wallet and the resulting balance and ledger entry.
WAL-002 Wallet Transaction History verifies paginated rendering of wallet transactions, including ordering and cursor handling.
CHK-001 Guest Checkout verifies a complete purchase without an authenticated account, covering address entry, totals, and order confirmation.
CHK-002 Promotion Code verifies that a promotion code applies at checkout and adjusts the order total. It is sensitive to discount and rounding configuration.
LOG-001 Password Login verifies credential submission, session establishment, and redirect to the authenticated landing page.
LOG-002 Password Reset verifies the full reset workflow: reset request, token delivery, password change, and login with the new password.
WDR-001 Bank Withdrawal verifies a standard bank withdrawal request, including balance checks and jurisdiction validation before submission.
WDR-002 Withdrawal Limit verifies that a withdrawal above the configured regional limit is rejected with an explanatory message.
WDR-003 Withdrawal Cancellation verifies that a pending withdrawal can be cancelled and that the funds are returned to the available balance.
